#!/usr/bin/env python3 """In-VNet private-connectivity validator + HTML report server. Runs INSIDE the private VNet (Azure Container Instance, VNet-injected) where the Foundry and AI Search resources have public network access DISABLED. It: 1. Acquires Entra ID tokens via the user-assigned managed identity (IMDS). 2. Validates private DNS resolution (public FQDNs must resolve to private 10.x endpoint IPs, not public IPs). 3. Proves general internet egress is BLOCKED by the subnet NSG. 4. Makes AUTHENTICATED data-plane calls through the private endpoints to: - Microsoft Foundry (primary region) - Azure AI Search (secondary region -> cross-region private link) and expects HTTP 200. 5. Renders a styled HTML summary report and serves it on :80 so it can be viewed from anywhere inside the VNet (peered network / Bastion / VPN / another container). Configuration comes from environment variables (injected by the container): CLIENT_ID user-assigned managed identity client id FOUNDRY_HOST .openai.azure.com FOUNDRY_REGION primary region label (display only) SEARCH_HOST .search.windows.net SEARCH_REGION secondary region label (display only) DNS_HOSTS space-separated FQDNs to resolve REFRESH_SECONDS report refresh / loop interval (default 180) Only the Python standard library is used (the azure-cli image ships python3). """ import os import ssl import json import time import html import socket import datetime import functools import threading import http.server import urllib.error import urllib.request CLIENT_ID = os.environ.get("CLIENT_ID", "") FOUNDRY_HOST = os.environ.get("FOUNDRY_HOST", "") FOUNDRY_REGION = os.environ.get("FOUNDRY_REGION", "primary") SEARCH_HOST = os.environ.get("SEARCH_HOST", "") SEARCH_REGION = os.environ.get("SEARCH_REGION", "secondary") DNS_HOSTS = os.environ.get("DNS_HOSTS", "").split() REFRESH = int(os.environ.get("REFRESH_SECONDS", "180")) try: CONFIG = json.loads(os.environ.get("CONFIG_JSON", "") or "{}") except Exception: CONFIG = {} SITE = "/site" INDEX = os.path.join(SITE, "index.html") IMDS = "http://169.254.169.254/metadata/identity/oauth2/token?api-version=2018-02-01" def get_token(resource): """Acquire an Entra ID access token for `resource` from IMDS.""" url = "{0}&resource={1}&client_id={2}".format(IMDS, resource, CLIENT_ID) req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Metadata": "true"}) try: with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as resp: return json.load(resp).get("access_token", "") except Exception: return "" def is_private_ip(ip): try: parts = [int(p) for p in ip.split(".")] except ValueError: return False if len(parts) != 4: return False if parts[0] == 10: return True if parts[0] == 192 and parts[1] == 168: return True if parts[0] == 172 and 16 <= parts[1] <= 31: return True return False def resolve(host): """Return the sorted set of IPs `host` resolves to (empty on failure).""" try: infos = socket.getaddrinfo(host, 443, socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) return sorted({info[4][0] for info in infos}) except Exception: return [] def internet_blocked(target=("1.1.1.1", 443), timeout=6): """True if outbound internet is blocked (connection cannot be established).""" try: with socket.create_connection(target, timeout=timeout): return False # connected -> internet reachable except Exception: return True # blocked / timed out -> expected behaviour def https_get(url, token, timeout=20): """Authenticated GET. Returns (status_code, latency_ms, snippet).""" ctx = ssl.create_default_context() ctx.check_hostname = False ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE headers = {} if token: headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + token req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers) start = time.time() try: with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout, context=ctx) as resp: body = resp.read(240).decode("utf-8", "ignore") return resp.status, int((time.time() - start) * 1000), body except urllib.error.HTTPError as err: body = err.read(240).decode("utf-8", "ignore") return err.code, int((time.time() - start) * 1000), body except Exception as err: return 0, int((time.time() - start) * 1000), str(err) def auth_call(url, token, retries=6, delay=15): """Call an endpoint, retrying transient RBAC-propagation 403/000 results.""" status, latency, body = https_get(url, token) attempts = 1 while status in (0, 403) and attempts < retries: time.sleep(delay) status, latency, body = https_get(url, token) attempts += 1 return status, latency, body, attempts def badge(ok): return ('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL') def _g(obj, *keys, default=""): """Safe nested getter for the CONFIG dict.""" cur = obj for k in keys: if isinstance(cur, dict) and k in cur: cur = cur[k] else: return default return cur def run_checks(): """Run every validation and return a structured result dict.""" now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC") cog_token = get_token("https://cognitiveservices.azure.com") search_token = get_token("https://search.azure.com") # 1. Private DNS resolution. dns_rows = [] dns_ok = bool(DNS_HOSTS) for host in DNS_HOSTS: ips = resolve(host) private = bool(ips) and all(is_private_ip(ip) for ip in ips) dns_ok = dns_ok and private dns_rows.append({ "host": host, "ips": ", ".join(ips) if ips else "(no answer)", "ok": private, }) # 2. Internet egress blocked. inet_blocked = internet_blocked() # 3. Token acquisition. tokens_ok = bool(cog_token) and bool(search_token) # 4. Foundry private data-plane (primary region). foundry_url = "https://{0}/openai/models?api-version=2024-10-21".format(FOUNDRY_HOST) f_status, f_ms, f_body, f_try = auth_call(foundry_url, cog_token) foundry_ok = f_status == 200 # 5. AI Search private data-plane (secondary region, cross-region). search_url = "https://{0}/indexes?api-version=2023-11-01".format(SEARCH_HOST) s_status, s_ms, s_body, s_try = auth_call(search_url, search_token) search_ok = s_status == 200 overall = dns_ok and inet_blocked and tokens_ok and foundry_ok and search_ok return { "now": now, "overall": overall, "dns_ok": dns_ok, "dns_rows": dns_rows, "inet_blocked": inet_blocked, "tokens_ok": tokens_ok, "cog_token": bool(cog_token), "search_token": bool(search_token), "foundry": {"ok": foundry_ok, "status": f_status, "ms": f_ms, "url": foundry_url, "tries": f_try}, "search": {"ok": search_ok, "status": s_status, "ms": s_ms, "url": search_url, "tries": s_try}, } def _tab_network(): e = html.escape vnet = _g(CONFIG, "vnet", default={}) rows = [] for sn in _g(vnet, "subnets", default=[]): rows.append( "{0}{1}" "{2}{3}{4}".format( e(sn.get("name", "")), e(sn.get("prefix", "")), e(sn.get("delegation", "")), e(sn.get("nsg", "")), e(sn.get("purpose", "")))) subnet_rows = "".join(rows) or "no config" return """

Virtual network

Name{name}
Address space{space}
Region{region}

Subnets, ranges & delegation

{rows}
SubnetRangeDelegationNSGPurpose
""".format( name=e(_g(vnet, "name")), space=e(_g(vnet, "addressSpace")), region=e(_g(CONFIG, "location")), rows=subnet_rows) def _dns_diagram_svg(): """Inline SVG illustrating the private DNS resolution + cross-region private link.""" e = html.escape f_region = e(_g(CONFIG, "foundry", "region") or FOUNDRY_REGION) s_region = e(_g(CONFIG, "search", "region") or SEARCH_REGION) return """

How private DNS + cross-region private link works

The report container in snet-web resolves each public FQDN through the VNet's Azure DNS, which is overridden by the linked privatelink.* zones to return a private 10.40.1.x address. Traffic then flows over the private endpoint to Foundry ({f_region}) and Search ({s_region}) — two different regions — without ever using a public IP or leaving the Microsoft backbone.

""".format(f_region=f_region, s_region=s_region) def _tab_dns(r): e = html.escape rows = [] for row in r["dns_rows"]: rows.append( "{0}{1}" "{2}".format( e(row["host"]), e(row["ips"]), badge(row["ok"]))) dns_table = "".join(rows) or "no hosts configured" zrows = [] for z in _g(CONFIG, "dnsZones", default=[]): zrows.append( "{0}{1}{2}".format( e(z.get("zone", "")), e(z.get("service", "")), badge(bool(z.get("linkedToVnet"))))) zone_table = "".join(zrows) or "no zones" return _dns_diagram_svg() + """

Private DNS zones (linked to VNet)

{zones}
ZoneBacksVNet link

Live DNS resolution (must be private 10.40.1.x)

{dns}
HostnameResolved IP(s)Private?
""".format(zones=zone_table, dns=dns_table) def _tab_services(r): e = html.escape f = r["foundry"] s = r["search"] fc = _g(CONFIG, "foundry", default={}) sc = _g(CONFIG, "search", default={}) def svc_card(title, cfg, region, status, ok): eps = "".join("
  • {0}
    • ".format(e(x)) for x in cfg.get("endpoints", [])) or "
  • n/a
    • " return """

    {title} {region}

    Resource{name}
    Kind / SKU{kind} · {sku}
    Public network access{pna}
    Auth{auth}
    Private endpoint{pe} → {pesub}
    Hello-world callHTTP {status} {bdg}

    Endpoints

      {eps}
    """.format( title=e(title), region=e(region), name=e(cfg.get("name", "")), kind=e(cfg.get("kind", "")), sku=e(cfg.get("sku", "")), pna=e(cfg.get("publicNetworkAccess", "")), auth=e(cfg.get("authMode", "")), pe=e(cfg.get("privateEndpoint", "")), pesub=e(cfg.get("peSubnet", "")), status=status, bdg=badge(ok), eps=eps) return (svc_card("Microsoft Foundry", fc, _g(fc, "region") or FOUNDRY_REGION, f["status"], f["ok"]) + svc_card("Azure AI Search (cross-region)", sc, _g(sc, "region") or SEARCH_REGION, s["status"], s["ok"])) def _tab_nsg(): e = html.escape rows = [] for n in _g(CONFIG, "nsgs", default=[]): rows.append( "{0}{1}{2}".format( e(n.get("name", "")), e(n.get("appliesTo", "")), e(n.get("summary", "")))) table = "".join(rows) or "no NSGs" return """

    Network security groups

    {rows}
    NSGSubnetRule summary

    Egress is locked down: only Entra ID (AzureActiveDirectory), Azure infrastructure (AzureCloud) and intra-VNet traffic are permitted; general Internet is denied. This is what proves the services are reachable only over private link.

    """.format(rows=table) def _tab_deploy(): e = html.escape dep = _g(CONFIG, "portalDeploymentsUrl") rgu = _g(CONFIG, "portalResourceGroupUrl") dep_link = ("View deployments in Azure portal".format(e(dep)) if dep else "n/a") rg_link = ("Open resource group".format(e(rgu)) if rgu else "n/a") return """

    Deployment

    Subscription{sub}
    Resource group{rg}
    Environment{env}
    Resource token{tok}
    IaC template{tpl}
    Portal — deployments{deplink}
    Portal — resource group{rglink}

    This environment is defined entirely in the Bicep template {tpl} and deployed with az deployment group create.

    """.format( sub=e(_g(CONFIG, "subscriptionId")), rg=e(_g(CONFIG, "resourceGroup")), env=e(_g(CONFIG, "environmentName")), tok=e(_g(CONFIG, "resourceToken")), tpl=e(_g(CONFIG, "templatePath")), deplink=dep_link, rglink=rg_link) def render_html(r): """Build the tabbed HTML report from a results dict.""" e = html.escape banner_cls = "ok" if r["overall"] else "bad" banner_txt = ("ALL PRIVATE CONNECTIVITY CHECKS PASSED" if r["overall"] else "ONE OR MORE CHECKS FAILED") f = r["foundry"] s = r["search"] f_region = _g(CONFIG, "foundry", "region") or FOUNDRY_REGION s_region = _g(CONFIG, "search", "region") or SEARCH_REGION status_tab = """

    Summary

    CheckDetailResult
    Private DNS resolutionpublic FQDNs resolve to private 10.x endpoint IPs{dns_badge}
    Internet egress blockedsubnet NSG denies general internet (tested 1.1.1.1:443){inet_badge}
    Managed-identity tokensCognitive: {cog}, Search: {srch}{tok_badge}
    Foundry private endpoint {f_region}authenticated GET /openai/models → HTTP {f_status} ({f_ms} ms){f_badge}
    AI Search private endpoint {s_region} · cross-regionauthenticated GET /indexes → HTTP {s_status} ({s_ms} ms){s_badge}

    Cross-region “hello world” (live)

    Both services have public network access disabled. These authenticated calls succeed only because the report container reaches them over private endpoints — and the two services sit in different regions.

    Microsoft Foundry
    {f_region}
    GET /openai/models
    HTTP {f_status} · {f_ms} ms {f_badge}
    ↔
    cross-region
    private link
    Azure AI Search
    {s_region}
    GET /indexes
    HTTP {s_status} · {s_ms} ms {s_badge}
    """.format( dns_badge=badge(r["dns_ok"]), inet_badge=badge(r["inet_blocked"]), tok_badge=badge(r["tokens_ok"]), cog="present" if r["cog_token"] else "EMPTY", srch="present" if r["search_token"] else "EMPTY", f_region=e(f_region), s_region=e(s_region), f_status=f["status"], f_ms=f["ms"], f_badge=badge(f["ok"]), s_status=s["status"], s_ms=s["ms"], s_badge=badge(s["ok"]), f_state="ok" if f["ok"] else "bad", s_state="ok" if s["ok"] else "bad") tabs = [ ("status", "Status", status_tab), ("network", "Network", _tab_network()), ("dns", "Private DNS", _tab_dns(r)), ("services", "Services", _tab_services(r)), ("nsg", "NSG", _tab_nsg()), ("deploy", "Deployment", _tab_deploy()), ] nav = "".join( "".format(tid, tlabel) for tid, tlabel, _ in tabs) panes = "".join( "
    {1}
    ".format(tid, body) for tid, _, body in tabs) return """ Private Connectivity Report

    Private Connectivity Validation

    Served from inside the VNet · public network access is disabled on both services · generated {now}
    {banner_txt}
    {nav}
    {panes}
    Page auto-refreshes every {refresh}s. RBAC propagation can take several minutes after first deploy, so Foundry/Search may briefly show 403 before turning green.
    """.format( refresh=REFRESH, now=e(r["now"]), banner_cls=banner_cls, banner_txt=banner_txt, nav=nav, panes=panes) def write_report(html_text): tmp = INDEX + ".tmp" with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh: fh.write(html_text) os.replace(tmp, INDEX) def report_loop(): while True: try: results = run_checks() write_report(render_html(results)) print("report updated: overall={0} foundry={1} search={2}".format( results["overall"], results["foundry"]["status"], results["search"]["status"]), flush=True) except Exception as err: # never let the loop die print("report error: {0}".format(err), flush=True) time.sleep(REFRESH) def main(): os.makedirs(SITE, exist_ok=True) write_report("

    Running private-connectivity checks…

    " "

    This page will refresh automatically.

    " "") threading.Thread(target=report_loop, daemon=True).start() handler = functools.partial(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, directory=SITE) server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 80), handler) print("serving report on :80", flush=True) server.serve_forever() if __name__ == "__main__": main()

nsgs.name: [format('nsg-aci-{0}', variables('resourceToken'))]
nsgs.summary: Outbound: allow AzureActiveDirectory + AzureCloud + VirtualNetwork; deny Internet. Inbound: default.

nsgs.summary: Inbound: allow client IP :80 + GatewayManager 65200-65535 + AzureLoadBalancer; deny Internet. Outbound: allow AAD + AzureCloud + VNet; deny Internet.

COGT=""; SRCT=""; n=0; while [ $n -lt 18 ]; do COGT=$(curl -s -m 20 -H "Metadata: true" "$TURL&resource=https://cognitiveservices.azure.com&client_id=$CID" | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(''access_token'',''''))" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$COGT" ]; then break; fi; n=$((n+1)); echo "token retry $n"; sleep 10; done; SRCT=$(curl -s -m 20 -H "Metadata: true" "$TURL&resource=https://search.azure.com&client_id=$CID" | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(''access_token'',''''))" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$COGT" ]; then echo COG_TOKEN=present; else echo COG_TOKEN=EMPTY; fi; if [ -n "$SRCT" ]; then echo SRCH_TOKEN=present; else echo SRCH_TOKEN=EMPTY; fi; echo "--- DNS (expect private 10.40.1.x) ---"; for h in {1}; do printf "RESOLVED %s -> " "$h"; getent hosts $h 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || printf DNSFAIL; echo ""; done; echo "--- Internet egress (expect BLOCKED by NSG Deny-Internet) ---"; printf "INTERNET 1.1.1.1 = "; curl -sS -k -m 12 -o /dev/null -w "%{{http_code}}" https://1.1.1.1/ 2>/dev/null && echo " (REACHED)" || echo BLOCKED; echo "--- Authenticated data-plane via private endpoint (expect 200) ---"; u="https://{2}/openai/models?api-version=2024-10-21"; sleep 10; done; echo "AUTHSTATUS foundry openai/models = $s"; u="https://{3}/indexes?api-version=2023-11-01"; s=000; j=0; while [ $j -lt 18 ]; do s=$(curl -sS -k -m 20 -o /dev/null -w "%{{http_code}}" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SRCT" "$u"); if [ "$s" != "403" ] && [ "$s" != "000" ]; then break; fi; j=$((j+1)); sleep 10; done; echo "AUTHSTATUS search indexes = $s"; echo PROBE_DONE', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('id-aci-{0}', variables('resourceToken'))), '2023-01-31').clientId, join(variables('probeHosts'), ' '), variables('foundryAuthHost'), variables('searchAuthHost'))]
